worker_claim.report: This invocation reached its implementation/context budget before the end-to-end owner workflow and isolation could be completed. Existing cgroup containment proves process lifetime, not evidence-only filesystem or credential isolation, so pending requests are explicitly refused rather than routed through ordinary workers or integration. No abandonment report publication or abandonment-specific resource retirement is enabled. Focused configured coverage validation passed 237 tests; after subsequent evidence refinements, 89 focused tests passed. Ruff and git diff --check passed. Full-suite attempts exceeded execution time limits; the latest parallel attempt reached approximately 73 percent without a reported failure before timeout, which is not a full-suite pass. All new real-Git fixtures use disposable repositories; no live ticket or hosted operator resources were abandoned or retired.
worker_claim.summary: Added the abandoned board, strict abandonment request metadata and body validation, target reservation in ticket selection, and an explicit runtime admission refusal. Added an owner-only evidence library with chronological execution extraction, per-base deltas, rework review provenance, bounded inline excerpts and digest-verified artifact paging, plus documentation of the implemented boundaries.
